messages:
leo: quick RFC follow-up idea: rather than immediate deep benching, introduce a 'staging lane' that mirrors prod routing but uses sampled traffic and isolated infra. Staging lane would run a sequence: warmup -> perf microbench -> golden-set eval -> kv/onnx smoke. Thoughts?

erin: i like staging lane. helps catch runtime-only issues (kv miss patterns, allocator OOMs) that artifact-level checks miss. how do we seed traffic? synthetic vs sampled prod?

jaspreet: i'd prefer sampled prod traffic for behavioral fidelity, but that raises PII/compliance concerns. we can sanitize inputs and only sample metadata; for regulated customers we must allow opt-out.

nguyen: technical note: sampled prod traffic can be replayed deterministically into the staging lane if we store deidentified traces. replay runner needs to preserve tokenization + streaming hooks to match runtime path.

priya: tradeoffs: staging lane requires isolated GPU pools which costs. maybe run staging for first 72h after upload + on every major bump. after that, weekly sampled runs. also add a "staging_override" flag for critical deploys.

leo: agree. lifecycle idea: fast-accept (inline) -> staging lane (short-lived mirrored run) -> deep-validate async (full bench). Staging gives quicker runtime signal than waiting for full deep job.

erin: proposal for fast-accept checks: manifest sig, tokenizer roundtrip on 10 seeds, tiny greedy decode smoke. Nothing that needs large memory.

jaspreet: and staging should exercise KV and attention-cache paths with variable seqlens. add a small chaos step to surface concurrency races (e.g., concurrent requests that touch KV).

nguyen: implementation sketch (descriptor fields):
```
staging_policy: "enabled|first-72h|weekly_sample"
staging_sample_rate: 0.01
staging_sanitize: true
staging_override: boolean
```
This remains declarative in the registry.

priya: rollback behavior? if staging or deep fails, do we auto-disable? i prefer conservative: auto-flag + circuit to stable variant. only auto-disable for critical security regressions.

leo: so default: flag + shadow-degrade route to pinned stable model. we should surface a clear alert and block promoted traffic until an approver reviews.

erin: alerting: compare latency/p95, correctness score on golden set, and a kv-consistency metric. use thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.25 OR correctness drop > 3% triggers high priority. configurable per-customer.

jaspreet: we also need artifact signing so staging worker can verify provenance. add artifact_signature and signer_id to manifest.

nguyen: idempotency for staging/deep jobs: include job_key = sha256(model_version + artifact_hash + run_config). workers must write a run record to the model's audit log with status and telemetry pointers.

leo: ops concern: cost. we should support sampling policies and vendor quotas. also allow "local-only" mode for private deploy customers that want to run everything in their VPC.

probe-bot: created issue ADM-1402: staging-lane and deep-validate lifecycle + descriptor fields + rollout playbook. :spiral_note_pad:

priya: next actionable: leo will draft the staging-lane RFC patch with descriptor examples. nguyen + jaspreet take the runner prototype. erin will draft alert thresholds and rollback playbook.

leo: thanks — i'll tag the RFC PR WIP by EOD. keep scope tight: initial MVP = fast-accept + one short staging run on upload. no global weekly cadence for MVP.
